entities.summary: Jeffrey David Berwick is a Canadian-Dominican entrepreneur, libertarian and anarcho-capitalist activist. Berwick founded Stockhouse.com in 1994. In the late 1990s, the company expanded into eight countries and had 250 employees and a market cap of $240 million, during the tech bubble. He sold the company in 2002 for an 'undisclosed' amount.
